## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you started.

### Install mcpmini in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure mcpmini package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to mcpmini
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub [repository](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/mcpmini):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/mcpmini.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/AnswerDotAI/mcpmini)

``` sh
$ conda install -c AnswerDotAI mcpmini
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/mcpmini/)

``` sh
$ pip install mcpmini
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub [repository](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/mcpmini)’s [pages](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/mcpmini/). Additionally you can find package manager specific guidelines on [conda](https://anaconda.org/AnswerDotAI/mcpmini) and [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/mcpmini/) respectively.
